summary_en: 100,000,000 shares (3.1% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired for up to ¥2.0B via open-market purchase on TSE from Aug 13, 2026 to Feb 26, 2027. All acquired shares to be cancelled on Mar 19, 2027. Reason: improved capital efficiency and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Terms for Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Treasury Stock Cancellation
translation_en_brief: SATO Corporation announced on Aug 12, 2026 that its board has resolved to acquire up to 1,000,000 shares of its own common stock (3.1% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for an aggregate consideration not to exceed ¥2.0 billion. Acquisition will take place via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from Aug 13, 2026 through Feb 26, 2027. The company states the reason as improved capital efficiency and enhanced shareholder returns. All shares acquired under this program are to be cancelled on Mar 19, 2027; the final count of cancelled shares will be announced following completion of the acquisition. As of Jun 30, 2026, the company held 1,166,703 treasury shares against 32,469,239 shares outstanding ex-treasury.
